text: Objective: Through one semester study, students could improve Chinese skills in a short time and achieve relevant HSK certificate. Courses: Chinese Pronunciation, Chinsese Vocabulary, Chinese Grammar, Chinese Reading and Listening, HSK Reading, HSK Writing, HSK Listening, HSK Oral Test, Chinese Daily Conversation etc. Notes: The program will open if the number of applicants are over 10 or above. It could accept group and individual registration. Group class could decide the study content and study time.
